subject.title: feat: make managed SKU registration claims atomic

question: Should Commerce permanently expose the ManagedSkuRegistrationClaimPort and managedSkuClaims storage collection as the public atomic-registration contract?
rationale: The implementation changes the plugin's supported API and stored model; that boundary cannot be selected from test results alone.

options.title: Approve the claim contract
options.body: Accept the provider-neutral claim port and additive collection as the supported Commerce boundary, then merge subject to normal checks.

options.title: Narrow or internalize it
options.body: Define a smaller or non-exported integration boundary before this capability lands.

recommendation.title: Approve the claim contract
recommendation.body: Accept the provider-neutral claim port and additive collection as the supported Commerce boundary, then merge subject to normal checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature-history evidence most directly connects this contributor to the preceding and proposed registration-contract lineage.
